display_long_description:
Step into Billionaires Show: Quiz Time, an immersive single-player VR trivia game show where every answer brings you closer to the Billionaires Club. Face the lights, take your seat in the booth and test your general knowledge across 500+ brand-new questions covering history, geography, science, space, sports, movies, television, music, art, celebrities, global culture and pop culture.

Every round is built to challenge your memory, speed and judgment. Use four strategic superpowers to overcome difficult questions, recover from mistakes and keep your run alive when the pressure rises. Your goal is simple but brutal: answer all 30 questions correctly, secure the perfect score and earn your place in the Hall of Fame.

The latest update expands the question library, improves the category mix and delivers sharper visuals with smoother performance. With a massive pool of questions, unpredictable rounds and a high-stakes game-show atmosphere, no two sessions feel the same. Compete against yourself, improve your score and return for another shot at the perfect run.

Designed for both seated and standing play, Billionaires Show combines brain training, competition and sci-fi spectacle in one replayable VR quiz experience. Whether you love trivia, general knowledge, quiz games, game shows or competitive challenges, this is your chance to prove what you know under pressure.

The studio is ready. The host is waiting. One question remains: are you ready to become a billionaire?
